[SERVICE DOMAIN: Collateral Asset Administration] BIAN Service Landscape V14.0 - vista MATRIX
UBICACION Business Area : Operations and Execution Business Domain : Cross Product Operations Anidado : Collateral Administration (capacidad de negocio agrupadora, no un nivel del metamodelo)
BUSINESS DEFINITION (proposito) This service domain maintains the status of a customers collateral assets, including s cheduled and ad-hoc valuations
METAMODELO Control Record = Asset Type + Generic Artifact Functional Pattern : Administer Asset Type : Collateral Asset Generic Artifact : Administrative Plan Control Record : Collateral Asset Administrative Plan

BEHAVIOR QUALIFIERS (2) Valuation (5 atributos) Maintenance (4 atributos)
